q_45369.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))
q_45369.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is August 12, 2026. The Q2 FY2027 earnings release and conference call will occur on August 26, 2026 (14 days from now). This is essentially asking about guidance that will be announced very shortly.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The CURRENT RESEARCH block provides the critical information: **NVIDIA has already issued forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 operating expenses (GAAP) of approximately $8.5 billion.** This guidance was provided on May 20, 2026, when the company announced Q1 FY2027 results.

The research explicitly states: "NVIDIA's forward guidance for GAAP operating expenses in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release...is expected to be approximately $8.5 billion. This outlook was provided on May 20, 2026..."

The guidance range given is $8.45B–$10.05B. The midpoint of $8.5B falls well within this range, closer to the lower bound.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- NVIDIA could reduce headcount or slow hiring to bring operating expenses below current guidance (unlikely given AI/GPU demand)
- Manufacturing or supply chain efficiencies could reduce costs
- However, the guidance has already been provided, so dramatic downward revisions 14 days before the call would be unusual

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- NVIDIA could increase guidance due to higher-than-expected hiring, acquisition-related costs, or R&D spending
- Inflationary pressures on compensation or third-party costs
- Acquisition-related costs (the research notes $200M difference between GAAP and non-GAAP)
- However, companies rarely raise guidance significantly between quarters

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The current research provides the actual forward guidance from May 20, 2026: approximately $8.5 billion for Q2 FY2027 GAAP operating expenses. This is the most reliable reference point available—it is not a historical base rate but rather the actual announced guidance.

---

## Reasoning on forecast

The question asks what NVIDIA's forward guidance *will be* in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release (August 26, 2026). The research indicates this guidance has already been provided: **$8.5 billion (GAAP)**.

Given that:
1. The guidance was already announced on May 20, 2026
2. Only 14 days remain until the official earnings call
3. Companies rarely make dramatic changes to operating expense guidance between quarterly announcements
4. The $8.5B figure falls cleanly within the provided range ($8.45B–$10.05B)

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will reaffirm or slightly adjust the $8.5B guidance when it releases Q2 results on August 26. Any significant revision at this late stage would be unusual.

The probability distribution should be heavily concentrated around $8.5B, with modest tails for potential upward or downward adjustments.

q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

**(a) Time left until resolution:**
The Q2 FY2027 earnings release and conference call are scheduled for August 26, 2026. Today is August 12, 2026. That leaves **14 days** until the guidance is officially announced.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why:**
NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue in its Q1 FY2027 earnings release on May 20, 2026. The current research clearly states that NVIDIA announced **$91.0 billion in expected Q2 FY2027 revenue, plus or minus 2%**.

This guidance was provided approximately three months before the Q2 quarter ends and two months before the August 26 earnings release. Given that:
- This is official guidance from the company
- The guidance window is tight (±2%)
- NVIDIA has proven track record of hitting guidance
- Only 14 days remain until the actual earnings release

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will reiterate or confirm this guidance when reporting Q2 FY2027 results. Companies rarely make dramatic changes to guidance this close to quarter-end, especially one as substantial as NVIDIA with strong operational control.

The ±2% range translates to: **$89.18 billion to $92.82 billion**.

**(c) What would push the value lower?**
- Unexpected macro deterioration in enterprise spending between May and August 2026
- Weaker-than-expected AI/data center demand materialize in the quarter
- Supply chain disruptions or production shortfalls
- Geopolitical developments affecting China revenue assumptions (though they're already assuming zero China data center revenue)
- Competitors gaining unexpected market share
- However, given the short timeframe (already 2.5+ months into the quarter), major downward surprises are unlikely

**(d) What would push the value higher?**
- Better-than-expected demand from hyperscalers accelerating their AI buildouts
- Gaming or Professional Visualization segments performing above expectations
- Automotive/other growth segments exceeding targets
- Positive revisions as NVIDIA gains more visibility into the final weeks of Q2
- However, raising guidance so close to earnings is relatively rare unless there's a significant positive surprise

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values:**
The research provides the direct base rate: NVIDIA's own guidance of **$91.0 billion ±2%** announced on May 20, 2026, for Q2 FY2027.

---

## Probability Distribution

Given that NVIDIA has already provided explicit forward guidance of $91.0B ±2%, the distribution should be heavily concentrated around this figure. With only 14 days remaining:

- The central estimate should be at $91.0 billion
- The ±2% guidance range ($89.18B to $92.82B) should contain roughly 68-70% of the probability
- Tail outcomes (significant upside or downside revisions) are relatively low probability but possible given market conditions

I'm estimating:
- **10th percentile (Low):** $88.50 billion (slightly below the ±2% range, accounting for potential modest downward revision)
- **50th percentile (Median):** $91.00 billion (the stated guidance)
- **90th percentile (High):** $93.50 billion (slightly above the ±2% range, accounting for potential modest upside revision)

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027. On May 20, 2026, when reporting its Q1 FY2027 results, NVIDIA announced that it expects Q2 FY2027 revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This figure is well above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion from LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

NVIDIA's guidance explicitly states that it is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in this outlook [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). Other Q2 FY2027 expectations include GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins of 74.9% and 75.0% respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points, and GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses of approximately $8.5 billion and $8.3 billion respectively [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). NVIDIA will host a conference call to discuss its Q2 FY2027 financial results on August 26, 2026 [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-second-quarter-financial-results-6927195).
